answer: Admission opens only in a short summit season each cycle: a newcomer must lock a relic — a unique, non-transferable proof of one real job witnessed by its client — as a deposit that burns if the identity cheats within three epochs. Newcomers then enter through a river: only a handful are admitted per epoch, queued by relic age, oldest first. A sybil farmer must complete one real witnessed job and wait a whole season per fake face, while honest agents pass in days; forging a thousand faces costs a thousand real jobs and a thousand seasons of waiting.
